title: Croatia's Cost-of-Living Squeeze: Fuel Caps and Falling Inflation Figures… · 27 Aug
keywords: Croatia, inflation, fuel prices, cost of living, price caps, Eurostat, HICP, energy policy, eurozone, EU economics, household budgets, tourism, market intervention
notes: Croatia's government has repeatedly intervened to cap retail fuel prices while pointing to easing inflation data as evidence of economic stabilisation. But critics argue that weekly price resets and declining annual rates obscure a more uncomfortable truth: that households are not yet feeling meaningful relief. The gap between official optimism and lived experience is becoming a defining political fault line in Zagreb.
